# ada-url / unicode

ada-url's own fuzz target `unicode` ([source](source/unicode.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over ada (ada-url/ada at e6754478).

Checks 4 properties (listed below); the first, an invariant: Per-byte classification subset laws: forbidden_host => forbidden_domain, ascii_digit => ascii_hex_digit, lowercase_hex => ascii_hex_digit, and convert_hex_to_binary(c) <= 15 for hex digits.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against ada at commit e6754478.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- Per-byte classification subset laws: forbidden_host => forbidden_domain, ascii_digit => ascii_hex_digit, lowercase_hex => ascii_hex_digit, and convert_hex_to_binary(c) <= 15 for hex digits ([lines 27-70](source/unicode.cc#L27-L70)): abort(); confirmed in the binary.
- is_double_dot_path_segment and is_single_dot_path_segment are never both true ([lines 99-109](source/unicode.cc#L99-L109)): abort(); confirmed in the binary.
- Length/position bounds: prune_hash, trim_c0_whitespace and remove_ascii_tab_or_newline never lengthen; find_authority_delimiter(_special) and get_host_delimiter_location return positions <= size ([lines 137-196](source/unicode.cc#L137-L196)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.
- remove_ascii_tab_or_newline leaves no \t, \n or \r in its output ([lines 154-166](source/unicode.cc#L154-L166)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.

A failure of any of the checks at lines 27-70, lines 99-109 and lines 137-196 ends the process with a status that the halts statements below that name them exclude, so a proof of one of those statements implies them on every input it covers. No statement here proves the other check.
